warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

*** THE TWO ROOF COVERINGS ARE PRICED SEPARATELY AND IN VERY DIFFERENT PROPORTIONS: tile 207 ตร.ม. of laying labour against METAL SHEET 26 ตร.ม. *** That settles the A-02 either/or in favour of 'both, on different parts', exactly as A-06 draws it -- tile over the main house and the right wing, metal sheet over the car port and front terrace.
473 tiles for 207 ตร.ม. works out at about 2.3 tiles per square metre, the normal coverage for กระเบื้องลอนคู่.

THE HIP-ROOF GEOMETRY SHOWS UP IN THE RIDGE FITTINGS: 122 adjustable ridge/hip caps over 55 m of ridge-and-hip line, plus 7 hip-end closers, 2 three-way and 1 one-way junction. A-07 and S-06 between them show two ridges, six hips and one valley -- and the single ตะเข้รางน้ำ (valley gutter) line of 5 m matches that one valley.
*** THE 5 M STAINLESS VALLEY GUTTER IS A DIRECT CROSS-CHECK ON THE S-06 ROOF TOPOLOGY that had to be traced from line weights: exactly one valley, and it is short. ***
เชิงชาย + ทับเชิงชาย at 68 m and the PVC bird-guard at the same 68 m give the total eaves length -- a figure no drawing states.
'ตะปูเกลียวยึดกระเบื้อง 1,200 ตัว' against 473 tiles is roughly 2.5 screws per tile.
